subject: Fix search scoping leak in UBCa
description: Inner brane definitions (a=40) are leaking into outer scope when searching for `ab = a + b`. Need to fix search to only look at: 1) statements before current position in current brane, 2) ancestor branes walking up parent chain, 3) NEVER look inside child branes.
